item: A Stop is never the target's failure in six more recorders: the engagement epoch (R617 PR A)
summary: Six recorders the R617 audit named (1.1-1.5, 1.12; each claim verified first, all held) now take kill_switch_epoch() before the request, before the site's own head check where it has one, and ask kill_switch_engaged_since() after it (R614), so a Stop still engaged (R320) or pressed and cleared again inside the request records nothing. Stat subscriptions (refresh_due): stamped the cut subscription and every later one 'error' for 30 days; now nothing is stamped and the batch ends, counted skipped_offline. Hazard snapshot (auto_snapshot_due and the refresh=1 route): replaced the snapshot with the feeds that happened to answer for 6 h; now the previous snapshot is kept (the route still reports failures and saves posted records). Qualification pass: judged, stamped, laddered or logged no-evidence the cut candidate and every later one; now they are deferred, the pass returns before the cohort freeze when nothing is left, and the bulk job pauses on it instead of calling an empty pass complete. World discovery: marked a country the Stop cut mid-way done for good with the cut query as its error, read by the substring 'airplane' in str(exc); now the job pauses, the country stays undone, and host words that mention airplane mode are the country's error. Wiki dump and OSM downloads (_download, _pump): a Stop in connect, or the queued entry a paused worker pumped, became 'error' until Resume; now paused by airplane mode (the class NetworkBlocked covers a Stop between start()'s check and the worker's capture). Market feeds: classify_failed_check(exc, since=) with an epoch per import_feed attempt; a cleared Stop was the feed's verdict, now offline (the weather slice keeps the R320 read: its verdict is never cached). Tests: tests/test_kill_switch_epoch_recorders_r617.py, 39, production fetcher or guarded session with the airplane socket guard armed, *.example hosts; on the unchanged base 27 fail and the 12 controls pass; 23 mutants (epoch read removed per site, capture moved after the head check on the stats, hazards and discovery loops, the dump/OSM class and pump reads, the qualification early return and job read, csv since ignored, unpassed or shared across attempts) all killed by named tests. Stated cost: a genuine failure that shares its window with a Stop is not recorded, and is asked again. Release-notes line: Pressing Stop while statistics, hazard maps, source checks, source discovery, downloads or market prices were being fetched no longer marks them as failed or finished; they are simply tried again next time.
